name: Zipz Crispy Sticky Chicken Sandwich vs. Grilled Chicken (Avoid Chipotle)
whyItWorks: Zipz Sticky Chicken uses a sweet soy-ginger glaze rather than spicy chili pepper, making it far gentler than their Chipotle Chicken Sandwich when you want a remission treat.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Sticky Chicken Sandwich with sauce on the side and no raw lettuce or pickles (avoid the spicy Chipotle Chicken Sandwich completely).
watchOuts: Breaded and deep-fried chicken patty—choose a grilled chicken breast or plain turkey burger during flares
